name: Mitten Extracts | 3g Max Pro Disposable | Grape Kush
description:
Grape Kush is a heavy-hitting indica with rich grape flavors and subtle earthy undertones. Known for its deeply relaxing effects, it delivers a soothing body high that’s perfect for unwinding in the evening or before bed.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
